verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at doc.anytype.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as raw .md pages, which an agent can follow directly. Agent-oriented material backs it up: an agents skill documented for dropping into Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, an AGENTS.md in the repo, and a machine-readable OpenAPI v2 spec described as 'built for agents and humans.' missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or an llms.txt on the developers.anytype.io API portal, and no independent community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
